effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing 1 level 5 or lower blue [TS] trait Digimon card from your hand as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, until your opponent's turn ends, this Digimon can't be deleted in battle and gains ＜Blocker＞.
[Your Turn] When this Digimon unsuspends, it may digivolve into [Neptunemon] in the hand without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may play 1 level 4 or lower blue Digimon card with the [TS] trait from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
xros_req: [Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in any trait or w/[TS] trait: Cost 3
